Players Committee card image of [[Quite A Mercenary (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; errata mark “E”), printing: “USED: Cancel Elis Helrot or Stunning Leader. [Immune to Sense] OR Cancel a smuggler's game text for remainder of turn. OR ▲ Mercenary Armor or [Reflections II] Chewie. LOST: During your move phase, 'break cover' of an Undercover spy.” Uploaded unchanged.
